title: deploymentExecution
responsibility: Installs, checks, builds, uploads and health-checks an immutable source before recording its receipt.

inputs.name: deploymentExecution.reviewed
inputs.description: The reviewed plan (ReviewedDeployment) for one environment: plan.commit is checked out into a detached temporary worktree of reviewed.root, and plan.commit, plan.environment, plan.branch and reviewed.fingerprint are recorded on the receipt. Any entry in plan.blockers throws before source is prepared, and the whole object is passed to captureDeploymentTarget and to every verifyDeploymentSnapshot call.

inputs.name: deploymentExecution.runtime
inputs.description: The plugin is passed to captureDeploymentTarget, its deploy method receives the target and the source, and its id is recorded as the receipt adapter, while update(phase, detail) receives the preparing, checking, building, uploading and verifying phases. The optional execute and health members replace deploymentCommand and deploymentHealth, and those defaults apply when they are undefined or null.

outputs.name: deploymentExecution
outputs.type: Promise<{ environment: "dev" | "stage" | "preprod" | "prod"; commit: string; branch: string; adapter: string; updatedAt: string; deploymentId: string; url: string; configuration: string; }>
outputs.description: The receipt saved for the root after the health check and both final snapshot verifications pass: configuration is reviewed.fingerprint, deploymentId and url come from the plugin.deploy result, environment, commit and branch come from the plan, adapter is the plugin id, and updatedAt is the time the receipt is built. A failure at any earlier step throws before saveDeployment runs, so the stored receipt is not advanced.

errors.name: DeploymentExecutionError
errors.description: Thrown with the plan.blockers messages joined by spaces before any source is prepared, or with 'Deployment health verification failed; environment state was not advanced.' when the health check result is falsy. Errors from the awaited helpers propagate unchanged, and because saveDeployment is the final step, these errors leave the stored receipt unadvanced.
